The two concrete Schreier factor sets and their classes: fZ4 = carry cocycle a AND b (nonsplit Z/4), fKlein = constant 0 (split Klein). Both are 2-cocycles (fZ4_cocycle, fKlein_cocycle); fKlein is a coboundary (fKlein_isCoboundary); fZ4 is NOT a coboundary of any 1-cochain (fZ4_not_coboundary). Verdict: [Z/4] != 0 = [Klein] (classZ4_ne_zero, classKlein_eq_zero, classZ4_ne_classKlein). Machine-checked (Bool/decide).
